https://www.qbitai.com/2026/11/510416.ht.en_oneliner: Tongxin Intelligence, an AGI chip startup founded by veterans from Loongson and Hygon and incubated by the Tong Research Institute, has surfaced after raising hundreds of millions of yuan within six months, aiming to answer the compute question behind general intelligence with a single chip.

https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBM.zh_title: Anthropic上市会带来更好的AI监管吗？
https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBM.zh_oneliner: 随着Anthropic走近上市，外界开始讨论这家以安全著称的AI公司进入公开市场后是否会推动监管向更严格的方向发展。
https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBM.en_title: Will Anthropic's IPO lead to better AI regulation? - The Korea Times
https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBM.en_oneliner: As Anthropic approaches its IPO, observers are asking whether the safety-focused AI company going public will push regulation in a stricter direction.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17338.zh_title: LLM智能体何时该遗忘？查询关键解析错误下的记忆过滤
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17338.zh_oneliner: 这篇论文指出，LLM记忆系统硬性删除被判定为过时的事实反而可能拖累下游任务的准确率，关键在于分辨何时遗忘才是安全的。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17338.en_title: When Should LLM Agents Forget? Memory Filtering Under Query-Critical Resolver Errors
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17338.en_oneliner: This paper shows that hard-deleting facts a memory system judges stale can actually hurt downstream accuracy, so the real question is when forgetting is safe.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17339.zh_title: 排名还成立吗？面向从业者的小型量化端侧LLM幻觉检测器审计
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17339.zh_oneliner: 该研究面向实际部署场景，检验了主流幻觉检测方法在小型量化端侧模型上的表现是否依然可靠，为从业者选型提供了实测依据。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17339.en_title: Does the Ranking Hold? A Practitioner-Facing Audit of Hallucination Detectors on Small, Quantized, On-Device LLMs
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17339.en_oneliner: Aimed at real deployments, this study tests whether leading hallucination detectors still hold up on small, quantized on-device models, giving practitioners measured evidence for choosing one.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17340.zh_title: LoRAWeaver：LoRA表征空间中的方向性适配器路由
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17340.zh_oneliner: LoRAWeaver提出在LoRA表征空间中按方向路由适配器，让大模型在多次低成本微调后仍能保持各任务的能力而不互相干扰。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17340.en_title: LoRAWeaver: Directional Adapter Routing in LoRA Representation Space
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17340.en_oneliner: LoRAWeaver routes adapters by direction inside LoRA representation space, letting a large model keep each task's ability intact across repeated low-cost fine-tuning rounds.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17341.zh_title: 表格人群先验作为电子病历用药集预测的结构化检索
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17341.zh_oneliner: 该研究把人群层面的用药统计先验做成结构化检索信号，用来提升基于电子病历的用药组合预测准确性。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17341.en_title: Tabular Population Priors as Structured Retrieval for EHR Medication Set Prediction
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17341.en_oneliner: This study turns population-level medication statistics into a structured retrieval signal to improve medication-set prediction from electronic health records.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17495.zh_title: 不透明串行深度的操作化定义
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17495.zh_oneliner: 这篇论文为“不透明串行深度”给出可操作的定义，用来衡量当模型架构变化让思维链监控变得更难时，内部推理到底有多不可见。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17495.en_title: An Operationalization of Opaque Serial Depth
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17495.en_oneliner: This paper gives an operational definition of opaque serial depth, measuring how invisible a model's internal reasoning becomes when architectural shifts make chain-of-thought monitoring harder.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17501.zh_title: 用微缩放格式推进R&R模型的量化
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17501.zh_oneliner: 该研究用微缩放数值格式对推荐与排序模型做量化，在保持精度的同时大幅提升推理吞吐，适配广告等高并发场景。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17501.en_title: Advancing Quantization for R&R Models with Microscaling Formats
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17501.en_oneliner: This study applies microscaling formats to quantize recommendation and ranking models, boosting inference throughput for high-concurrency settings like advertising while preserving accuracy.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17515.zh_title: 推一把下山：框架效应与内部状态干预对长周期LLM智能体串谋行为的影响
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17515.zh_oneliner: 研究把Gemma 3 12B放进模拟法庭场景，检验持续的得失框架提示能否把长周期智能体推向市场操纵式的串谋行为。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17515.en_title: A Push Down the Mountain: Framing Effects and Internal State Interventions on Collusive Behavior in a Long-Horizon LLM Agent
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17515.en_oneliner: The study places Gemma 3 12B in a simulated courtroom to test whether sustained gain-loss framing can push a long-horizon agent toward market-manipulating collusion.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17524.zh_title: 模型退火：通过回顾与巩固实现数据高效学习
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17524.zh_oneliner: 模型退火借鉴“复习巩固”的思路，让小标注数据集在训练中被反复利用而不只是死记硬背，从而用更少的数据学得更好。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17524.en_title: Model Annealing: Data-Efficient Learning through Review and Consolidation
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17524.en_oneliner: Model annealing borrows the idea of review and consolidation, letting a small labeled dataset be reused through training instead of merely memorized, so the model learns more from less data.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17532.zh_title: 星形胶质细胞生物计算：星形胶质细胞对神经网络计算的贡献
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17532.zh_oneliner: 这篇论文从星形胶质细胞获得灵感，探讨大脑中这类“指挥家”式细胞如何调节神经网络计算，并为新型计算架构提供思路。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17532.en_title: Astrocyte Biocomputing: Astrocytic Contributions to Neural Network Computation
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17532.en_oneliner: Drawing inspiration from astrocytes, this paper explores how these conductor-like brain cells modulate neural network computation and what they suggest for new computing architectures.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17539.zh_title: 可验证pXRD：用LLM智能体爬山法解析粉末X射线衍射结构
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17539.zh_oneliner: 该研究让LLM智能体用爬山搜索从粉末X射线衍射数据中自主解析晶体结构，为无人值守的材料实验室打通关键瓶颈。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17539.en_title: Verifiable pXRD: Hill-climbing pXRD structure determination with LLM agents
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17539.en_oneliner: This study has LLM agents use hill-climbing search to autonomously determine crystal structures from powder X-ray diffraction data, clearing a key bottleneck for self-driving materials labs.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17564.zh_title: AI-Voyager：面向公众利益的人机公民推理系统，挑战并塑造治理AI的规则
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17564.zh_oneliner: AI-Voyager是一个面向公众利益的系统，帮助普通人参与关于AI规则的讨论，让受规则影响的人也能对自动化决策的定义发声。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17564.en_title: AI-Voyager: A Public-Interest System for Human-AI Civic Reasoning to Contest and Shape the Rules That Govern AI
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17564.en_oneliner: AI-Voyager is a public-interest system that helps ordinary people take part in debates over AI rules, giving those affected by them a voice in defining automated decisions and harms.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17583.zh_title: 信息越少反而越划算？表征、收益与成本的精确有限图谱
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17583.zh_oneliner: 这篇论文用精确的有限图谱证明，保留更少信息的表征有时反而能取得更好的任务收益，挑战了“信息越多越好”的直觉。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17583.en_title: When Does Less Information Pay? An Exact Finite Atlas of Representation, Payoff, and Cost
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17583.en_oneliner: Using an exact finite atlas, this paper shows that a representation keeping less information can sometimes deliver better task payoff, challenging the intuition that more information is always better.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17610.zh_title: 更多智能体、更多采样还是更多思考？拆解多智能体LLM中的协调、集成与测试时计算
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17610.zh_oneliner: 该研究拆开了多智能体评估中常被混淆的三个因素，厘清性能提升到底来自智能体之间的协调、结果集成，还是单纯增加了测试时计算。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17610.en_title: More Agents, More Samples, or More Thinking? Untangling Coordination, Ensembling, and Test-Time Compute in Multi-Agent LLMs
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17610.en_oneliner: This study disentangles three factors often confused in multi-agent evaluations, clarifying whether gains come from coordination between agents, ensembling results, or simply more test-time compute.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17616.zh_title: LLM引导的行为聚类生命周期管理：决定何时以及如何演化行为聚类
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17616.zh_oneliner: 用户行为聚类会随时间分裂、合并甚至消失，这项研究让LLM来判断聚类何时需要演化以及该如何调整。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17616.en_title: LLM-Guided Cluster Lifecycle Management: Deciding When and How to Evolve Behavioral Clusters
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17616.en_oneliner: Behavioral clusters split, merge, or vanish over time, and this study uses an LLM to decide when a cluster needs to evolve and how to adjust it.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17620.zh_title: 预防性人格引导的安全副作用：实证审计
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17620.zh_oneliner: 该研究实测发现，用引导手段提前抑制谄媚、幻觉等行为时，可能会在模型中引发意料之外的安全副作用，提醒开发者谨慎使用这类干预。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17620.en_title: Safety Side Effects of Preventative Persona Steering: An Empirical Audit
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17620.en_oneliner: This audit finds that steering a model in advance to suppress behaviors like sycophancy and hallucination can trigger unexpected safety side effects, warning developers to use such interventions carefully.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17621.zh_title: AscendGYM：面向昇腾NPU真实工作负载的成本感知算子优化基准
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17621.zh_oneliner: AscendGYM为昇腾NPU上的大模型训练与推理算子优化建立了一个贴近真实负载、同时考虑成本的评测基准。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17621.en_title: AscendGYM: A Cost-Aware Kernel Optimization Benchmark for Real-World Workloads on Ascend NPUs
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17621.en_oneliner: AscendGYM sets up a benchmark for kernel optimization on Ascend NPUs that reflects real LLM training and inference workloads while factoring in cost.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17632.zh_title: 生成式评估套件：以多样性驱动的搜索发现智能体的真实回归
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17632.zh_oneliner: 该研究把评估套件生成看作多样性驱动的搜索，用覆盖需求与角色组合的描述空间来系统性地挖出智能体的真实回归问题。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17632.en_title: Generated Evaluation Suites as Diversity-Driven Search for Real Agent Regressions
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17632.en_oneliner: This study treats evaluation-suite generation as diversity-driven search, covering a descriptor space of requirements and personas to systematically uncover real regressions in agents.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17639.zh_title: LLM智能体看到什么，用户又说了什么
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17639.zh_oneliner: 当智能体要替用户取消预订或删除文件时，这篇论文追问真正阻止它按错误假设行动的，到底是工具返回的信息还是用户说的话。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17639.en_title: What LLM Agents See and What Users Say
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17639.en_oneliner: When an agent is about to cancel a booking or delete a file for a user, this paper digs into what actually keeps it from acting on a wrong assumption — the information its tools return, or the user's own words.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17662.zh_title: 先学后下注：学习可解释规则以实现可靠的智能体干预
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17662.zh_oneliner: 针对动辄运行数百步的自主智能体，该研究先学习可解释的干预规则，再据此在恰当时机出手干预，让长时间运行更可靠。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17662.en_title: Learn then Bet: Learning Interpretable Rules for Reliable Agent Intervention
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17662.en_oneliner: For autonomous agents that run for hundreds of steps, this study first learns interpretable intervention rules and then acts on them at the right moments to make long runs more reliable.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17680.zh_title: 一致、冲突还是未指定？多模态时间序列预测的诊断基准
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17680.zh_oneliner: 当物联网时间序列遇上专家报告等外部文本时，这项基准专门诊断两者信号一致、冲突或缺失时，预测模型到底会如何表现。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17680.en_title: Aligned, Conflicting, or Unspecified? A Diagnostic Benchmark for Multimodal Time Series Forecasting
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17680.en_oneliner: When IoT time series meet external text like expert reports, this benchmark diagnoses how forecasting models behave when those signals agree, conflict, or go unspecified.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17681.zh_title: OCTAVE：面向端到端HTML5游戏生成的按能力拆解基准
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17681.zh_oneliner: OCTAVE把完整的HTML5游戏生成拆成按能力划分的评测维度，不再只用一个总分来衡量智能体能否协调规则、交互、状态与呈现。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17681.en_title: OCTAVE: A Capability-Resolved Benchmark for End-to-End HTML5 Game Generation
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17681.en_oneliner: OCTAVE breaks end-to-end HTML5 game generation into capability-resolved evaluation dimensions instead of a single aggregate score, testing whether an agent can coordinate rules, interaction, state, and presentation.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17696.zh_title: Co-Sight Harness：面向长周期商业智能体的外置控制资产与确定性执行
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17696.zh_oneliner: 针对长周期商业流程中错误累积、知识散落的问题，Co-Sight Harness把控制资产外置并用确定性机制强制执行，让智能体按既定流程走完长链条任务。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17696.en_title: Co-Sight Harness: Externalized Control Assets and Deterministic Enforcement for Long-Horizon Business Agents
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17696.en_oneliner: For long business workflows where errors accumulate and needed knowledge scatters, Co-Sight Harness externalizes control assets and enforces them deterministically so agents complete long task chains as specified.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17704.zh_title: AI驱动的高分辨率叶绿素a预测模型，优于现行全球业务化生物地球化学系统
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17704.zh_oneliner: 这个AI模型能以更高分辨率预测海洋表层叶绿素a的短期分布，表现超过现行的全球业务化生物地球化学预报系统。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17704.en_title: An AI-enabled high-resolution chlorophyll-a forecasting model that outperforms the operational global biogeochemical system
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17704.en_oneliner: This AI model forecasts surface chlorophyll-a distribution at higher resolution and outperforms the operational global biogeochemical system in short-term predictions.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17710.zh_title: 跨语言语音生物标志物：交互与单人语音任务中的认知障碍声学特征
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17710.zh_oneliner: 该研究从多语言语音中提取声学特征来筛查认知障碍，覆盖对话与独白两种任务场景，目标是让痴呆早筛更公平、更可扩展。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17710.en_title: Cross-Linguistic Acoustic Biomarkers of Cognitive Impairment Across Interactive and Single-Speaker Speech Tasks
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17710.en_oneliner: This study extracts acoustic features from multilingual speech to screen for cognitive impairment across conversational and single-speaker tasks, aiming to make dementia screening fairer and more scalable.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17722.zh_title: 分布式网络上的联邦软多层学习及收敛保证
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17722.zh_oneliner: 这篇论文提出一种面向分布式网络的联邦多层学习方法，并给出收敛性保证，让双层等多层优化问题能在去中心化场景下可靠求解。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17722.en_title: Federated Soft Poly-Level Learning Over a Distributed Network with Guaranteed Convergence
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17722.en_oneliner: This paper proposes a federated multi-level learning method for distributed networks with guaranteed convergence, so multi-level optimization problems like bilevel optimization can be solved reliably in decentralized settings.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17728.zh_title: 模型合并中通用代理正则化的谱框架
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17728.zh_oneliner: 模型合并常因参数互相干扰而掉点，该研究用谱分析框架给出一种通用代理正则化方法，让多任务模型合并时少受干扰。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17728.en_title: A Spectral Framework for Universal Proxy Regularization in Model Merging
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17728.en_oneliner: Model merging often degrades performance through parameter interference, and this study offers a spectral framework for universal proxy regularization that keeps merged multi-task models less affected by it.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17763.zh_title: 崩塌之后的知识：语境与措辞如何影响语言模型中事实的可及性
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17763.zh_oneliner: 当语言模型接受了一个错误纠正后，后续对话的语境与措辞会决定它还能不能找回正确的事实，这篇论文系统揭示了这种“知识崩塌”现象。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17763.en_title: Knowledge After Collapse: Context and Wording Shape Factual Accessibility in Language Models
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17763.en_oneliner: After a language model accepts a false correction, the context and wording of the conversation determine whether it can still retrieve the right fact, and this paper systematically reveals that knowledge-collapse phenomenon.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17776.zh_title: 经认证的Thomson问题最优构型改进：用LLM智能体搭建的搜索流程
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17776.zh_oneliner: 研究团队用LLM智能体搭建搜索流程，改进了球面上电荷排布这一经典Thomson问题的已知最优构型，并给出了可验证的证明。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17776.en_title: Certified Improvements to Best-Known Thomson-Problem Configurations with a Search Pipeline Built with Large Language Model Agents
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17776.en_oneliner: The team built a search pipeline with LLM agents that improves the best-known configurations for the classic Thomson problem of arranging charges on a sphere, with certified verification.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17781.zh_title: TReC：评估指令条件围棋中落子引发的状态变化
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17781.zh_oneliner: TReC不再只看围棋模型的落子离专家答案有多远，而是评估每一步落子如何改变棋局状态，从而更准确地衡量模型的理解。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17781.en_title: TReC: Evaluating Move-Induced State Changes in Instruction-Conditioned Go
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17781.en_oneliner: Instead of only measuring how far a Go model's move lands from the expert's, TReC evaluates how each move changes the board state, giving a sharper measure of the model's understanding.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17790.zh_title: AutoRL：面向自主强化学习的多智能体系统
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17790.zh_oneliner: AutoRL用多智能体系统推动强化学习的自动化，目标是让AI系统自己完成强化学习的训练流程，迈向递归自我改进。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17790.en_title: AutoRL: A Multi-Agent System towards Autonomous Reinforcement Learning
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17790.en_oneliner: AutoRL uses a multi-agent system to automate reinforcement learning itself, aiming for AI systems that run their own RL training pipelines toward recursive self-improvement.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17793.zh_title: MASTARS：面向多智能体强化学习的回报条件子目标序列轨迹增强
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17793.zh_oneliner: 离线多智能体强化学习受限于固定数据集的质量，MASTARS通过生成回报条件子目标来扩充轨迹，从而提升学习效果。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17793.en_title: MASTARS: Multi-Agent Sequential Trajectory Augmentation with Return-Conditioned Subgoals
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17793.en_oneliner: Offline multi-agent reinforcement learning is limited by the quality of its fixed dataset, and MASTARS augments trajectories with return-conditioned subgoals to improve learning.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17796.zh_title: 不完整观测下GPU云定价基准的稳健性评估：一项受控缺失性研究
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17796.zh_oneliner: 当GPU租赁市场的报价缺失时，每日定价基准可能失真，这项研究在四种受控缺失模式下检验了常用中位数规则的稳健性。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17796.en_title: Robustness Evaluation of GPU Cloud Pricing Benchmarks under Incomplete Observations: A Controlled Missingness Study
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17796.en_oneliner: When GPU rental marketplace quotes go missing, daily price benchmarks can distort, and this study stress-tests the common median rule under four controlled missingness patterns.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17797.zh_title: Vision-as-a-Tool：面向多模态智能体编程的视觉工具框架
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17797.zh_oneliner: 多模态智能体编程需要看懂代码运行后的视觉结果，Vision-as-a-Tool把视觉能力做成工具，让智能体能观察并评估自己生成的产物。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17797.en_title: Vision-as-a-Tool: Visual Harness for Multimodal Agentic Coding
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17797.en_oneliner: Multimodal agentic coding needs to see the visual results of generated code, and Vision-as-a-Tool turns visual ability into a tool so agents can observe and evaluate their own artifacts.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17806.zh_title: 智能体能跟上时间吗？对话中断后时间适应的实证分析
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17806.zh_oneliner: 当长期助手与用户中断对话一段时间后再回来，它能否正确处理时间变化，这篇论文实测了智能体在对话间隙后的时间适应能力。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17806.en_title: Can Agents Keep Up with Time? An Empirical Analysis of Temporal Adaptation After a Conversational Hiatus
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17806.en_oneliner: When a long-horizon assistant returns after a conversational hiatus, this paper empirically tests whether it can correctly handle the passage of time.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17814.zh_title: G-CAST：面向电商智能体持续自训练的治理框架
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17814.zh_oneliner: 这套框架让电商对话智能体在需求变化时持续自我训练，同时用治理机制守住行为边界。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17814.en_title: G-CAST: Governed Continual Self-Training for E-Commerce Agents under Evolving Demands
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17814.en_oneliner: This framework lets e-commerce conversational agents keep self-training as demands shift, while governance rules keep their behavior in bounds.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17819.zh_title: 因果约束与不确定性感知的肺心风险预测
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17819.zh_oneliner: 这项研究用常规胸部 CT 同时评估肺癌与心血管疾病风险，并给出不确定性估计来辅助临床判断。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17819.en_title: Causally Constrained and Uncertainty-Aware Cardiopulmonary Risk Prediction
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17819.en_oneliner: This study uses routine chest CT scans to jointly assess lung cancer and cardiovascular risk, adding uncertainty estimates to support clinical judgment.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17820.zh_title: 对齐 AI 团队：让多智能体协作保持一致
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17820.zh_oneliner: 这项研究探讨为什么针对单个智能体的对齐训练难以迁移到多智能体场景，并分析背后的机制。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17820.en_oneliner: This study explores why alignment training for a single agent often fails to transfer to multi-agent settings, and analyzes the underlying mechanism.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17846.zh_title: 去掉模型拒绝能力是不是越来越难了？Qwen3.8、Gemma 4 等新模型实测
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17846.zh_oneliner: 这项研究在 Qwen3.8、Gemma 4、Olmo 3.1 和 Mistral Small 3.2 上测试消融拒绝能力的难度，对比了新旧模型的差异。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17846.en_title: Is Abliteration Getting Harder? Not Uniformly: Refusal Removal by Direction-Based Ablation and ARA in Heretic on the Qwen3.8, Gemma 4, Olmo 3.1 and Mistral Small 3.2 LLMs Versus Their Predecessors
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17846.en_oneliner: This study tests how hard it is to strip refusal behavior from Qwen3.8, Gemma 4, Olmo 3.1 and Mistral Small 3.2, comparing them with their predecessors.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17856.zh_title: DECODE：诊断可解释性工具自身的失效
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17856.zh_oneliner: 这项工作指出用大模型自动解释大模型内部表征时会出现哪些失效，并给出诊断方法。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17856.en_title: DECODE: Diagnosing Interpretability Failures in Automated Interpretation Process
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17856.en_oneliner: This work identifies where automated interpretation of LLM internals breaks down and offers a way to diagnose those failures.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17858.zh_title: AI 辅助教育决策：不确定性、可解释性与人的责任
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17858.zh_oneliner: 这篇论文讨论 AI 进入教育决策后，如何处理不确定性与可解释性，以及人的责任该落在哪。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17858.en_title: AI-aided Decision-Making in Education - Uncertainty, Explainability, and Human Responsibility
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17858.en_oneliner: This paper discusses how uncertainty, explainability and human responsibility should be handled as AI enters educational decision-making.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17862.zh_title: FlexCast：面向时间序列基础模型的灵活上下文学习
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17862.zh_oneliner: 这项工作把时间序列基础模型里的上下文条件与预测解耦，让模型能灵活适应不同长度的历史窗口。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17862.en_title: FlexCast: Flexible Context Learning for Time Series Foundation Models
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17862.en_oneliner: This work disentangles context conditioning from prediction in time series foundation models so they can adapt flexibly to different history lengths.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17870.zh_title: OmniScore-Bench：评测视觉语言模型读乐谱的能力
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17870.zh_oneliner: 这个评测考察视觉语言模型能否读懂乐谱符号、还原结构并做出音乐层面的理解。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17870.en_title: OmniScore-Bench: Evaluating Vision-Language Models on Musical Score Reading
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17870.en_oneliner: This benchmark tests whether vision-language models can read musical notation, recover its structure and interpret it musically.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17880.zh_title: Soteria：带运行时约束的形式化验证 LLM 智能体规划
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17880.zh_oneliner: 这项工作用形式化验证加运行时强制执行，让多步工具调用的智能体既完成任务又不越过领域规则。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17880.en_title: Soteria: Formally Verified Planning with Runtime Enforcement for Safe LLM Agents
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17880.en_oneliner: This work combines formal verification with runtime enforcement so multi-step tool-calling agents complete tasks without breaking domain rules.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17910.zh_title: 攻击 LLM 规划器中的符号词汇漏洞
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17910.zh_oneliner: 这项研究揭示大模型规划器在符号层面的脆弱点，并展示针对性的对抗攻击如何让规划出错。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17910.en_title: Adversarially Attacking Symbolic Vocabulary Vulnerabilities In LLM Planners
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17910.en_oneliner: This study exposes symbolic-level vulnerabilities in LLM planners and shows how targeted adversarial attacks can derail their plans.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17915.zh_title: SWIFT：面向时间序列基础模型的样本级微调
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17915.zh_oneliner: 这项工作提出按样本微调时间序列基础模型的做法，让少样本预测适应得更快更准。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17915.en_title: SWIFT: Sample-Wise Instance Fine-Tuning of Time-Series Foundation Models for Forecasting
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17915.en_oneliner: This work proposes sample-wise fine-tuning for time series foundation models, making few-shot forecasting adapt faster and more accurately.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17917.zh_title: 合作方式必须改变时：多智能体强化学习中的语义策略遗忘
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17917.zh_oneliner: 这项研究让多智能体在协作策略过时后主动遗忘旧策略，重新学会配合。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17917.en_title: When Cooperation Must Change: Semantic Strategy Unlearning in Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17917.en_oneliner: This study lets multi-agent systems actively unlearn outdated cooperation strategies and relearn how to coordinate.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17921.zh_title: RecMem：面向长序列生成式推荐的循环记忆压缩
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17921.zh_oneliner: 这项工作用循环记忆压缩长交互历史，让生成式推荐既能看得远又不用付出线性增长的算力。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17921.en_title: RecMem: Recurrent Memory Compression for Long-Sequence Generative Recommendation
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17921.en_oneliner: This work compresses long interaction histories with recurrent memory so generative recommenders can use long context without linearly growing cost.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17925.zh_title: 平衡准确率在神经信号解码测试时适配中看不出什么
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17925.zh_oneliner: 这项研究指出在测试时自适应场景下，平衡准确率无法揭示神经信号解码的真实问题。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17925.en_title: What Balanced Accuracy Cannot Identify in Neural-Signal Decoding under Test-Time Adaptation
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17925.en_oneliner: This study shows that balanced accuracy fails to reveal the real problems of neural-signal decoding under test-time adaptation.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17929.zh_title: 在 Mac Studio 与 NVIDIA A100 上评测本地大模型做论文检索
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17929.zh_oneliner: 这项研究对比本地部署的大模型在科学文献检索上的成功率与延迟，考察它们能否替代云端服务。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17929.en_title: Evaluating Large Language Models for Scientific Paper Search: Retrieval Success and Inference Latency on Mac Studio and NVIDIA A100
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17929.en_oneliner: This study compares locally deployed LLMs on scientific paper search, measuring retrieval success and latency on Mac Studio and NVIDIA A100.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17933.zh_title: OutfitterBench：评测 LLM 智能体的长期资源分配与承诺协调
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17933.zh_oneliner: 这个评测考察智能体在长期任务里如何分配有限资源、兑现承诺，因为每个选择都会限制未来的行动。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17933.en_title: OutfitterBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Long-Horizon Resource Allocation and Commitment Coordination
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17933.en_oneliner: This benchmark tests how LLM agents allocate finite resources and honor commitments over long horizons, where each choice constrains future actions.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17937.zh_title: 用反事实见证图追溯真实原因
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17937.zh_oneliner: 这项工作用反事实见证图的形式化方法，追踪具体情境中到底是哪个事件导致了某个结果。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17937.en_title: Tracing Actual Causes with Counterfactual Witness Maps
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17937.en_oneliner: This work uses counterfactual witness maps to formally trace which event in a specific situation actually caused an outcome.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17938.zh_title: 从数据看 AI 视频生成的不可持续增长
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17938.zh_oneliner: 这项研究测算了商用文生视频的环境成本，指出服务商很少披露、而增长本身难以持续。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17938.en_title: Measured from the feed: the unsustainable growth of AI video generation
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17938.en_oneliner: This study measures the environmental cost of commercial text-to-video generation, noting providers rarely disclose it while growth itself looks unsustainable.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17950.zh_title: 面向抗干扰的射频信号分离
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17950.zh_oneliner: 这项工作让射频信号分离不再依赖针对特定干扰训练的专用模型，朝通用分离器迈进一步。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17950.en_oneliner: This work moves RF signal separation toward general separators that no longer need a dedicated model per interference type.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17953.zh_title: Transformer 范式：动态处理与新的推理原则
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17953.zh_oneliner: 这篇论文认为 Transformer 的意义不只是深度学习的量变，而是一种新的推理原则的出现。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17953.en_title: The Transformer Paradigm: Dynamic Processing and a New Principle of Inference
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17953.en_oneliner: This paper argues the Transformer revolution is not merely quantitative growth in deep learning but the emergence of a new principle of inference.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17955.zh_title: WebArena-Pro：面向网页智能体的异构多模态可复现评测
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17955.zh_oneliner: 这个评测让网页智能体在跨应用的真实浏览器任务里比拼，覆盖异构界面与多模态输入。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17955.en_title: WebArena-Pro: A Heterogeneous, Multimodal, Reproducible Benchmark for Web Agents
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17955.en_oneliner: This benchmark tests web agents on realistic cross-application browser tasks spanning heterogeneous interfaces and multimodal inputs.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17968.zh_title: TotalSegmentator 主动脉报告：CT 图像上 11 个标准位置的主动脉直径自动测量
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17968.zh_oneliner: 这个开源工具能在 CT 图像上自动量出 11 个标准位置的主动脉直径，供临床评估使用。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17968.en_title: TotalSegmentator Aorta Report: Automated Aortic Diameter Measurement at 11 Standardized Landmarks on CT Images
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17968.en_oneliner: This open-source tool automatically measures aortic diameters at 11 standardized landmarks on CT images for clinical assessment.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17983.zh_title: 交互式深度学习界面：脑肿瘤分割
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17983.zh_oneliner: 这个交互界面让医生在深度学习辅助下分割脑肿瘤，兼顾手术与放疗的实际需要。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17983.en_title: Interactive deep-learning based interface for brain tumour segmentation
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17983.en_oneliner: This interactive interface helps clinicians segment brain tumors with deep-learning assistance, serving both surgery and radiotherapy planning.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17991.zh_title: LACCO：低带宽网络下本地累积与计算通信重叠
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17991.zh_oneliner: 这项工作让语言模型在低带宽网络上训练时减少同步开销，把本地计算与通信重叠起来。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17991.en_title: LACCO: Local Accumulation with Computation--Communication Overlap
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17991.en_oneliner: This work cuts synchronization overhead when training language models over low-bandwidth networks by overlapping local computation with communication.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17998.zh_title: 快照式配电网故障诊断的局限
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17998.zh_oneliner: 这项研究分析逆变器接入后故障电流变弱，为什么只看某一时刻电压相量的快照诊断会失效。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17998.en_title: Understanding the limits of snapshot-based fault diagnosis in distribution networks
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17998.en_oneliner: The study looks at how inverter connections weaken fault currents and why diagnosing faults from a single snapshot of voltage phasors stops working.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18064.zh_title: A³：面向协作边缘计算的自适应音频智能体框架
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18064.zh_oneliner: 这个框架让嵌入式音频智能体在断网时也能本地工作，联网时再用边缘服务器提速。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18064.en_title: A$^3$: Adaptive Audio Agent Framework for Collaborative Edge Computing
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18064.en_oneliner: This framework lets embedded audio agents keep working locally when the link fails and use a nearby edge server for speed when connected.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18088.zh_title: 因果注意力中词元动态的双聚类状态
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18088.zh_oneliner: 这项研究部分证明并扩展了因果注意力掩码下词元聚类的猜想，揭示了动态随时间的变化规律。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18088.en_title: Two-Clustering Regime of Token Dynamics in Causal Attention
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18088.en_oneliner: This study partially resolves and extends a conjecture on token clustering under causal attention masking, revealing how the dynamics evolve over time.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18098.zh_title: 机器会从同伴那里学坏吗？AI 智能体偏差学习的随机试验
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18098.zh_oneliner: 这项随机试验检验 AI 智能体是否会像人一样，从同伴那里习得违规行为及其合理化解释。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18098.en_title: Do Machines Learn Deviance From Their Peers? A Randomized Test of Differential Association With AI Agents
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18098.en_oneliner: This randomized test checks whether AI agents, like people, pick up rule-breaking behavior and its justifications from their peers.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18121.zh_title: 用量子退火优化多材料结构钻孔轨迹
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18121.zh_oneliner: 这项工作用量子混合优化方法规划多材料结构上的钻孔路径，目标是减少加工成本。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18121.en_title: Optimizing Drilling Trajectories in Multi-Material Structures Using Quantum Annealers
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18121.en_oneliner: The authors plan drilling paths through multi-material structures with a quantum-hybrid optimizer, aiming to cut machining costs.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18130.zh_title: JFinBench：基于最新日本金融资格考试的持续刷新评测
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18130.zh_oneliner: 这个评测用最新的日本金融资格考试题持续考查大模型的金融能力，避免题目泄露过期。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18130.en_title: JFinBench: A Continuously Refreshable Japanese Financial Benchmark from the Latest Certification Exams
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18130.en_oneliner: This benchmark continuously tests LLMs on financial capability using the latest Japanese certification exams, keeping the questions fresh.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18140.zh_title: 大模型智能体自适应控制锂电池快充
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18140.zh_oneliner: 这项工作让大模型智能体在缩短充电时间与保持能量吞吐之间动态权衡，控制锂电池快充过程。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18140.en_title: Large Language Model-Empowered Intelligent Agent for Adaptive Fast-Charging Control of Lithium-Ion Batteries
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18140.en_oneliner: This work lets an LLM-powered agent dynamically balance charging speed against energy throughput to control lithium-ion fast charging.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18245.zh_title: 非确定性因果模型中的因果概率
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18245.zh_oneliner: 这项研究讨论在机制本身带有随机性的因果模型里，如何定义和计算因果概率。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18245.en_title: Probabilities of Causation in Nondeterministic Causal Models
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18245.en_oneliner: This study examines how to define and compute probabilities of causation when causal mechanisms remain intrinsically stochastic.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18248.zh_title: 词表网络上的舞动词元：从 LLM 生成看预训练几何
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18248.zh_oneliner: 这项研究从词表网络的几何结构出发，解释大模型逐词生成时某个具体输出与预训练的关系。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18248.en_title: Dancing Tokens on the Vocabulary Network from LLM Generation
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18248.en_oneliner: Starting from the geometry of the vocabulary network, the study explains how a specific LLM output, generated word by word, connects back to pre-training.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18297.zh_title: 当评估变成干预：临床 AI 中的评判者效应
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18297.zh_oneliner: 这项研究指出，用 AI 评判临床 AI 输出时，评估本身会改变临床流程，变成一种干预。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18297.en_title: When evaluation becomes intervention in clinical AI
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18297.en_oneliner: This study shows that when AI judges grade clinical AI output, the evaluation itself changes clinical workflows and becomes an intervention.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18315.zh_title: 跨越模式的专家：面向跨库泛化的智能体引导关系专家混合模型
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18315.zh_oneliner: 这项工作让模型在不同平台、不同数据库模式之间迁移，解决关系数据结构不一致带来的泛化难题。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18315.en_title: Experts Across Schemas: Agent-Guided Mixture-of-Relational-Experts for Cross-Database Generalization
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18315.en_oneliner: This work helps models transfer across web platforms whose relational database schemas differ, tackling the generalization problem that mismatch creates.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18392.zh_title: VelServe：用尾部校准调度消除 LLM 推理解码抖动
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18392.zh_oneliner: 这项工作通过面向延迟目标的调度，让交互式 LLM 服务的首词延迟与词间延迟更稳定。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18392.en_title: VelServe: Taming Decode Jitters in LLM Inference with Tail-Calibrated Scheduling

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18395.zh_title: 智能家居智能体：有能力却不可预测的电网操作者

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18419.zh_title: LECAT：衡量 LLM 从预训练数据中学到的类别知识

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18419.en_oneliner: This benchmark measures how LLMs acquire category knowledge from pre-training data, such as knowing airplanes are fast but broken ones are not.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18434.zh_title: 用单通道脑电做可解释的睡眠分期
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18434.zh_oneliner: 这项工作让单通道脑电的自动睡眠分期变得可解释，以推动临床真正用起来。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18434.en_title: Towards Explainable Sleep Stage Classification using Single-Channel Electroencephalogram
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18434.en_oneliner: This work makes automated sleep staging from single-channel EEG interpretable enough for clinical adoption.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18458.zh_title: 何时相信模拟病人反应：血管加压药决策的支持门控世界模型

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18458.en_oneliner: This study adds a support gate to clinical world models so agents do not trust simulated patient responses when the evidence is thin.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18464.zh_title: 打字方式很重要：从腕部肌电实时解码按键

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18464.en_oneliner: This study recovers typed text from wrist surface EMG signals and shows muscle, language and typing habits all affect decoding accuracy.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18494.zh_title: ARCHER：让小语言模型从模仿推理走向可执行推理
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18494.zh_oneliner: 这项工作让小语言模型不再只模仿推理过程，而是学会真正可执行的推理，从而在数学任务上更可靠。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18494.en_title: ARCHER: From Rationale Imitation to Executable Reasoning in Small Language Models
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18494.en_oneliner: This work moves small language models from imitating reasoning traces to executable reasoning, making them more reliable on math tasks.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18514.zh_title: 机制可解释性能解释 LLM 智能体失败吗？网页元素幻觉案例研究

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18514.en_oneliner: This case study tests whether mechanistic interpretability can explain why an LLM agent hallucinates web elements that do not exist.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18531.zh_title: 社会化对齐：在选择压力下学习权衡
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18531.zh_oneliner: 这项研究用进化视角看智能体如何在完成任务与遵守行为规范冲突时学会取舍。

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18531.en_oneliner: This study takes an evolutionary view of how AI agents learn to trade off task completion against rules of conduct when the two conflict.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18533.zh_title: ModHarness-RL：把智能体支架变成可学习、可演化的程序
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18533.zh_oneliner: 这项工作把智能体强化学习里的支架从固定脚手架变成可学习、可演化的程序，让训练更灵活。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18533.en_title: ModHarness-RL: Recasting Harnesses as Learnable and Evolving Programs for Agentic RL
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18533.en_oneliner: This work turns the harness in agentic reinforcement learning from a fixed scaffold into a learnable, evolving program.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18543.zh_title: 用示范引导的多智能体强化学习
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.18543.zh_oneliner: 这项工作把示范学习扩展到多智能体强化学习，让智能体从示例中更快学会协作。

https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.24098.zh_title: HARDTESTGEN：面向 LLM 算法编程的高质量强化学习验证器生成流程
https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.24098.zh_oneliner: 这个流程自动生成高质量验证器，给大模型算法编程的强化学习提供可靠的奖励信号。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.24098.en_title: HARDTESTGEN: A High-Quality RL Verifier Generation Pipeline for LLM Algorithmic Coding
https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.24098.en_oneliner: This pipeline automatically generates high-quality verifiers that provide reliable reward signals for RL on LLM algorithmic coding.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05003.zh_title: PhysDox：评测 LLM 审核生理传感实验方案的物理可行性
https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05003.zh_oneliner: 这个评测考察大模型能否发现实验方案里看似流畅却物理上不可行的部分。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.05003.en_title: PhysDox: Benchmarking LLMs on Physical Feasibility Auditing of Physiological Sensing Protocols

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17354.zh_title: 量子经典混合序列模型：用更少样本做量能器能量回归
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17354.zh_oneliner: 这项工作用量子经典混合模型从电磁量能器数据中重建能量，样本效率更高。

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17381.zh_title: ProdPilot：让 vibe 编码项目自动达到生产就绪的分层 MCP 系统

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17381.en_title: ProdPilot: A Layered Model Context Protocol System for Automated Production Readiness and Deployment of Vibe-Coded Projects
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17381.en_oneliner: This layered MCP system checks AI-assisted vibe-coded projects and automatically brings them to production readiness.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17388.zh_title: 面向软件工程智能体的分层代码图时间一致评估

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17388.en_oneliner: This work requires SWE agent evaluation to strictly separate pre-existing repository knowledge from future code evolution to avoid temporal leakage.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17390.zh_title: 枚举后验支持的先验：有限积分交叉分类测量映射的一阶误差

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17391.zh_title: 自信却错了：结构置信度筛不出有功能的蛋白设计

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17395.zh_title: 大模型会写后门吗？权重空间编程的安全实证研究

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17412.zh_title: WETW：学习成对加权欧氏距离加速 DTW 搜索

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17440.zh_title: 从行为轨迹理解编程智能体

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17440.en_oneliner: This work looks beyond binary task success for coding agents, analyzing behavioral trajectories to reveal how success and failure arise.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17442.zh_title: 与时间赛跑：教视觉语言导航按预算找东西

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17462.zh_title: 扩散树采样：晶体生成模型的推理时自适应

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17462.en_oneliner: This work lets crystal generative models adapt at inference time, turning a strong prior into more promising candidate structures.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17466.zh_title: 用 NeOn 方法为环境辅助生活做用例驱动的本体建模

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17472.en_oneliner: This study tests whether ensembling mixture-of-experts routers genuinely improves performance or merely repeats single-network gains.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17505.zh_title: 对抗追踪：攻击自动驾驶汽车图像传感器的目标跟踪

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17505.en_title: Adversarial Tracking: Attacks on Image Sensors for Object Tracking in Autonomous Vehicles

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17520.zh_title: 只与最弱的智能体一样安全：多智能体系统独有的突破口

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17527.zh_title: GraphScent：为有限上下文代码定位校准方向性相关信号

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17556.en_oneliner: This synthetic benchmark tests whether causal discovery methods can find which recorded variables truly drive product quality, yield or energy use.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17629.zh_title: 免训练加速多视角 3D Transformer：按状态感知的注意力近似

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17644.zh_title: CoTTAGE：面向文生音频的可解释评判器

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17658.en_oneliner: This study reveals how robot imitation policies learn to discount noisy position readings and quantifies the closed-loop cost of doing so.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17768.zh_title: 在《台风》中用激活引导掌舵南山号

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17780.zh_title: LuthorSQL：一次通过的 Text-to-SQL 模型，做慢速 LLM 智能体的快系统

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17802.zh_title: 多模态人物概念模型：在多变观察条件下认人

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17808.zh_title: CarryOn：让长程 LLM 智能体学会该在上下文里留什么

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17808.en_oneliner: This work teaches long-horizon LLM agents to keep only the context that matters as their interaction histories grow.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17821.zh_title: SceneAgent：面向可移植游戏场景生成的多智能体框架

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17831.zh_title: V-JEPA-LM：读懂动态的视频语言模型

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17866.zh_title: 用区分性查询主动学习时序规约

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24161.en_title: TorchTPU - A Hybrid Eager/Compiled Architecture for Native PyTorch Execution on TPU
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24161.en_oneliner: This open-source collaboration between Google and Meta brings a native PyTorch backend to TPUs, combining eager and compiled execution.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24349.zh_title: FlashRT-PAI：快核不等于快流水线，面向物理 AI
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24349.zh_oneliner: 这项工作指出视觉语言动作等物理 AI 模型里，单个算子快不代表整条实时流水线快，瓶颈在别处。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24349.en_title: FlashRT-PAI: Fast Kernels Are Not Fast Pipelines for Physical AI
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24349.en_oneliner: This work shows that in physical AI systems, fast kernels do not mean fast pipelines, and the bottleneck lies elsewhere.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24471.zh_title: 大模型的多元对齐：目标、人类参照与偏好表征
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24471.zh_oneliner: 这项工作主张对齐不该把人类多样化的偏好压成单一目标，而要保留有意义的差异。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24471.en_title: Pluralistic Alignment in Large Language Models: Objectives, Human References, and Preference Representations
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.24471.en_oneliner: Rather than squeezing diverse human preferences into one target, alignment should keep meaningful differences intact, the work argues.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26002.zh_title: TimesJev：用快系统思维做时间序列推理
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26002.zh_oneliner: 这项工作让大模型做时间序列推理时像快系统一样直接作答，而不必每次都慢想。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26002.en_title: TimesJev: Thinking Fast on Time Series with System 1 Sufficiency
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.26002.en_oneliner: This work lets LLMs reason over time series with fast System 1-style thinking instead of slow deliberation every time.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30499.zh_title: 大模型能改进自己的支架吗？ARC-AGI-3 上的对照研究
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30499.zh_oneliner: 这项对照研究检验通用智能系统能否不靠人类重新设计软件脚手架，就高效习得新技能。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30499.en_title: Can LLMs Improve Their Own Harness? A Controlled Study on ARC-AGI-3
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.30499.en_oneliner: This controlled study tests whether a generally intelligent system can acquire new skills efficiently without humans redesigning its software scaffold.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00782.zh_title: 一个偏移、两个方向：用子群偏移调整 GRPO 基线
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00782.zh_oneliner: 这项工作指出 GRPO 用组内均值做基线在实践中有问题，于是用子群偏移来修正基线估计。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00782.en_title: One Offset, Two Directions: Baseline Adjustment via Subgroup Offsets
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.00782.en_oneliner: This work fixes a practical flaw in GRPO's within-group mean baseline by adjusting it with subgroup offsets.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05798.zh_title: 视觉权重读取器的保功能审计
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05798.zh_oneliner: 这项研究指出同一个图像可以用不同权重编码，审计读取器时必须保证它依赖的是功能而非参数巧合。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05798.en_title: Function-Preserving Audits of Visual Weight Readers
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.05798.en_oneliner: Because the same image can be encoded with different weights, auditing a reader has to verify it relies on function rather than a coincidence of parameters, the study notes.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08752.zh_title: AttentionSwitch：用稀疏注意力头选择与缩放联合学习防御 LLM 越狱
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08752.zh_oneliner: 这项工作通过联合学习选出并缩放关键注意力头，让大模型更难被越狱攻击绕过。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08752.en_title: AttentionSwitch: Jailbreak Defense for LLMs via Joint Learning of Sparse Attention-Head Selection and Scaling
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08752.en_oneliner: This work defends LLMs against jailbreak attacks by jointly learning which attention heads to select and how to scale them.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09326.zh_title: ABHBench：从智能体视角评估基础模型的道德决策
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09326.zh_oneliner: 这个评测把基础模型当作能感知并自主行动的智能体，检验它们的道德决策能力。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09326.en_title: ABHBench: Evaluating Moral Decision-Making of Foundation Models from an Agentic Perspective
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.09326.en_oneliner: This benchmark evaluates the moral decision-making of foundation models from an agentic perspective.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12762.zh_title: Sage-Taiyi：面向科学发现的元认知架构
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12762.zh_oneliner: 这个元认知启发的架构用积累的科学理解来指导下一步该研究什么，推动科学发现。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12762.en_title: Sage-Taiyi: A Metacognitive Architecture for Scientific Discovery
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.12762.en_oneliner: Drawing on metacognition, this architecture steers what to study next from the scientific understanding it has already built up, speeding discovery along.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.13710.zh_title: AutoManifold：用智能体设计基于流形嵌入的数据可视化算法
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.13710.zh_oneliner: 这项研究让智能体自动设计流形嵌入的可视化算法，不再依赖少数几种人工设计的经典方法。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.13710.en_title: AutoManifold: Agentic Design of Data Visualisation Algorithms via Manifold Embedding
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.13710.en_oneliner: This work lets agents automatically design manifold-embedding visualisation algorithms instead of relying on a handful of hand-designed classics.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15315.zh_title: MIGRO：面向语言模型的可解耦、可移植长期记忆系统
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15315.zh_oneliner: MIGRO 把用户交互中积累的观察、修正和上下文从模型本身解耦出来，让长期记忆可以在模型换代后继续使用。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15315.en_title: MIGRO: A Decoupled and Portable Long-Term Memory System for Language Models
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15315.en_oneliner: MIGRO decouples observations, revisions, and context accumulated from user interaction from the model itself, so long-term memory survives model upgrades.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15592.zh_title: 小模型头、强决策：类型化决策模型的对照研究
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15592.zh_oneliner: 这项对照研究考察了 TypeSafe 的 Jev 这类类型化决策模型，验证小规模决策头如何输出带校准的类型化决策。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15592.en_title: Small Heads, Strong Decisions: A Controlled Study of Typed-Decision Models
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.15592.en_oneliner: This controlled study examines typed-decision models like TypeSafe's Jev, testing how small decision heads produce calibrated, typed decisions.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16318.zh_title: AI 风险行为基准测试
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16318.zh_oneliner: 这项研究在不同场景和任务要求下评估大模型的冒险倾向，系统地衡量模型是偏保守还是偏激进。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16318.en_oneliner: This study evaluates LLMs' risk propensity across contexts and task demands, systematically measuring whether models lean risk-averse or risk-tolerant.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16937.zh_title: S1-Evo：针对类型化 System-1 决策模型的经验引导证据竞争攻击
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16937.zh_oneliner: S1-Evo 揭示了部署在智能体路由、审核和授权环节的类型化快思考决策模型，仍可能被精心设计的证据竞争攻击绕过。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16937.en_title: S1-Evo: Experience-Guided Evidence Competition Attacks on Typed System-1 Decision Models
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.16937.en_oneliner: S1-Evo shows that typed System-1 decision models deployed for agent routing, moderation, and authorization can still be bypassed by carefully crafted evidence-competition attacks.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17241.zh_title: Ballad：用 Bandit 做 LLM 路由的自动化启发式发现
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17241.zh_oneliner: Ballad 用 Bandit 算法为大模型选择路由，让自动化启发式发现系统在迭代中自己找到更好的启发式方法。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17241.en_title: Ballad: Bandit-Based LLM Routing for Automated Heuristic Discovery
https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.17241.en_oneliner: Ballad uses bandit algorithms to route LLM calls, letting automated heuristic discovery systems find better heuristics on their own through iteration.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.08674.zh_title: 假新闻检测器对大模型生成的文本存在偏见
https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.08674.zh_oneliner: 研究发现，假新闻检测器会系统性地把大模型生成的文本误判为假新闻，暴露了现有检测方法对机器生成内容的偏见。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.08674.en_title: Fake News Detectors are Biased against Texts Generated by Large Language Models
https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.08674.en_oneliner: The study finds fake-news detectors systematically misclassify LLM-generated text as fake news, exposing a bias in current detection methods against machine-generated content.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.00788.zh_title: Astraios：面向代码大模型的高效参数指令微调
https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.00788.zh_oneliner: Astraios 用参数高效微调替代全参数微调，让代码大模型的指令微调成本大幅下降。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.00788.en_title: Astraios: Parameter-Efficient Instruction Tuning Code Large Language Models
https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.00788.en_oneliner: Astraios replaces full-parameter fine-tuning with parameter-efficient methods, sharply cutting the cost of instruction-tuning code LLMs.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.15877.zh_title: BigCodeBench：用多样函数调用与复杂指令评测代码生成
https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.15877.zh_oneliner: BigCodeBench 用包含多样函数调用和复杂指令的任务评测大模型写代码的能力，比只看简单代码片段的基准更贴近真实开发场景。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.15877.en_title: BigCodeBench: Benchmarking Code Generation with Diverse Function Calls and Complex Instructions
https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.15877.en_oneliner: BigCodeBench evaluates LLM code generation with tasks involving diverse function calls and complex instructions, closer to real development than benchmarks that only test simple snippets.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.06191.zh_title: 两层 ReLU 网络回归中的良性过拟合
https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.06191.zh_oneliner: 这项研究分析了用梯度下降训练的两层 ReLU 网络在回归任务里为何过拟合却不损害泛化，揭示了良性过拟合的成立条件。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.06191.en_title: Benign Overfitting for Regression with Trained Two-Layer ReLU Networks
https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.06191.en_oneliner: This study analyses why two-layer ReLU networks trained by gradient descent can overfit regression tasks without harming generalization, revealing the conditions for benign overfitting.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.13013.zh_title: LEGAL-UQA：用英乌平行基准测试面向乌尔都语使用者的宪法问答系统
https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.13013.zh_oneliner: LEGAL-UQA 提供了一个英乌双语平行基准，用来检验法律信息助手能否可靠地帮乌尔都语使用者理解自己的宪法权利。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.13013.en_title: LEGAL-UQA: Testing Constitutional Question-Answering Systems for Urdu Speakers with a Parallel English-Urdu Benchmark
https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.13013.en_oneliner: LEGAL-UQA provides a parallel English-Urdu benchmark for testing whether legal information assistants reliably help Urdu speakers understand their constitutional rights.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.12358.zh_title: AbFlowNet：用扩散与 GFlowNet 融合优化抗体抗原结合能
https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.12358.zh_oneliner: AbFlowNet 把扩散模型与 GFlowNet 结合起来优化抗体的互补决定区，让设计的抗体与目标抗原结合得更牢。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.12358.en_title: AbFlowNet: Optimizing Antibody-Antigen Binding Energy via Diffusion-GFlowNet Fusion
https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.12358.en_oneliner: AbFlowNet combines diffusion models with GFlowNet to optimize antibody complementarity-determining regions so designed antibodies bind their target antigens more tightly.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.18934.zh_title: 卡方小波图神经网络：面向异构图异常检测
https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.18934.zh_oneliner: 这项研究用卡方小波图神经网络处理异构图里节点和边的多样性，让图异常检测在复杂网络中更准确。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.18934.en_title: Chi-Square Wavelet Graph Neural Networks for Heterogeneous Graph Anomaly Detection
https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.18934.en_oneliner: This work uses chi-square wavelet graph neural networks to handle node and edge diversity in heterogeneous graphs, making graph anomaly detection more accurate in complex networks.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.23373.zh_title: Graph Your Own Prompt：用图结构约束提示
https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.23373.zh_oneliner: 这项研究提出图一致性正则化方法，把从模型预测中提炼的关系图结构注入提示，让提示优化更稳定可靠。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.23373.en_oneliner: This work proposes graph consistency regularization, injecting relational graph structures derived from model predictions into prompts to make prompt optimization more stable and reliable.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.08697.zh_title: BigCodeArena：用执行结果揭示代码生成中更可靠的人类偏好
https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.08697.zh_oneliner: BigCodeArena 借鉴 Chatbot Arena 的众包评测思路，用实际执行结果来衡量代码生成质量，让人类偏好评测更可信。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.08697.en_title: BigCodeArena: Unveiling More Reliable Human Preferences in Code Generation via Execution
https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.08697.en_oneliner: BigCodeArena borrows the crowdsourced evaluation idea of Chatbot Arena and uses actual execution results to judge code generation quality, making human-preference evaluation more trustworthy.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.22953.zh_title: 流形近似带来更稳健的核对齐
https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.22953.zh_oneliner: 这项研究发现，用流形近似改进中心核对齐指标，可以更稳健地比较神经网络的表征和判断模型等价性。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.22953.en_title: Manifold Approximation leads to Robust Kernel Alignment
https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.22953.en_oneliner: This study finds that improving centered kernel alignment with manifold approximation makes comparing neural network representations and judging model equivalence more robust.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.21542.zh_title: E0：用 Tweedie 离散扩散为视觉-语言-动作模型预测精细离散动作
https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.21542.zh_oneliner: E0 把 Tweedie 离散扩散引入视觉-语言-动作模型，让机器人在操作任务中能预测更精细、更具表现力的离散动作。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.21542.en_title: E0: Expressive Fine-Grained Discrete Action Prediction for Vision-Language-Action Models via Tweedie Discrete Diffusion
https://arxiv.org/abs/2511.21542.en_oneliner: E0 brings Tweedie discrete diffusion to vision-language-action models so robots can predict finer, more expressive discrete actions in manipulation tasks.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.05024.zh_title: 用分位数曲线无模型评估模拟器保真度
https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.05024.zh_oneliner: 这项研究提出用分位数曲线衡量生成式 AI 模拟现实系统的 sim-to-real 差距，无需对模拟器做额外假设。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.05024.en_title: Model-Free Assessment of Simulator Fidelity via Quantile Curves
https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.05024.en_oneliner: This work proposes quantile curves to measure the sim-to-real gap of generative AI simulators without extra assumptions about the simulator.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.05844.zh_title: NEAT：面向 3D 分子生成的邻域引导高效自回归集合 Transformer
https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.05844.zh_oneliner: NEAT 用邻域引导的自回归 Transformer 生成 3D 分子，比扩散和流模型更高效，为药物设计提供了一种更快的生成路线。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.05844.en_title: NEAT: Neighborhood-Guided, Efficient, Autoregressive Set Transformer for 3D Molecular Generation
https://arxiv.org/abs/2512.05844.en_oneliner: NEAT uses a neighborhood-guided autoregressive Transformer to generate 3D molecules more efficiently than diffusion and flow models, offering a faster generative route for drug design.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.01547.zh_title: 视觉-语言模型在物理动态与意图推理上仍落后于人类
https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.01547.zh_oneliner: 研究发现，视觉-语言模型在理解开放场景中的物理互动和推测意图方面仍明显弱于人类，空间智能仍是短板。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.01547.en_title: Vision-language models lag human performance on physical dynamics and intent reasoning
https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.01547.en_oneliner: The study finds vision-language models still lag humans clearly in understanding physical interactions and inferring intent in open scenes, leaving spatial intelligence a weak spot.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.08732.zh_title: ISLA：用集成学习与域适应提升急性缺血性脑卒中病灶分割的泛化能力
https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.08732.zh_oneliner: ISLA 结合集成学习与域适应，让急性缺血性脑卒中病灶在扩散 MRI 上的分割更通用，并通过临床验证确认了实用价值。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.08732.en_title: ISLA: Ensemble learning and domain adaptation for generalizable acute ischemic stroke lesion segmentation in diffusion MRI with clinical validation
https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.08732.en_oneliner: ISLA combines ensemble learning and domain adaptation to make acute ischemic stroke lesion segmentation on diffusion MRI more generalizable, with clinical validation confirming its practical value.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.15235.zh_title: 用 2D 描画追踪 3D 解剖结构：投影掩码能否替代 3D 分割来识别颈椎骨折
https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.15235.zh_oneliner: 这项研究检验了从投影得到的掩码是否足以替代完整的 3D 分割来识别颈椎骨折，目标是让 CT 自动判读更快、成本更低。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.15235.en_title: Tracing 3D Anatomy in 2D Strokes: Can Projection-Derived Masks Replace 3D Segmentation for Cervical Spine Fracture Recognition?
https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.15235.en_oneliner: This study tests whether projection-derived masks can replace full 3D segmentation for cervical spine fracture recognition, aiming to make automatic CT interpretation faster and cheaper.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.02557.zh_title: 对齐诅咒：模态对齐让文本攻击迁移到音频
https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.02557.zh_oneliner: 研究发现，端到端全模态模型强化文本与音频的对齐后，针对文本的攻击可以迁移到音频上，放大了音频攻击的风险。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.02557.en_title: The Alignment Curse: Modality Alignment Supercharges Audio Attacks via Text Transfer
https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.02557.en_oneliner: The study finds that when end-to-end omni-models strengthen text-audio modality alignment, attacks crafted for text can transfer to audio, amplifying audio attack risks.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.11008.zh_title: ROCKET：用校准引导的背包增强截断快速压缩模型
https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.11008.zh_oneliner: ROCKET 是一种无需训练的模型压缩方法，用校准引导的截断策略在压缩比和性能之间取得领先表现。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.11008.en_title: ROCKET: Rapid Optimization via Calibration-guided Knapsack Enhanced Truncation for Efficient Model Compression
https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.11008.en_oneliner: ROCKET is a training-free model compression method that uses calibration-guided truncation to achieve leading performance at high compression ratios.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.15189.zh_title: ScrapeGraphAI-100k：面向模式约束 LLM 生成的数据集
https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.15189.zh_oneliner: 这个 10 万条规模的数据集专门训练大模型按指定 JSON 模式输出，为工具调用、结构化抽取和知识库构建打基础。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.15189.en_title: ScrapeGraphAI-100k: Dataset for Schema-Constrained LLM Generation
https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.15189.en_oneliner: Built from 100,000 examples, the dataset teaches LLMs to emit output matching a given JSON schema — groundwork for tool calls, structured extraction, and knowledge-base building.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.00496.zh_title: ESENSC：SHAP 的多项式时间公理化替代方案
https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.00496.zh_oneliner: ESENSC 用确定性的闭式归因替代 SHAP，在保持理论依据的同时把可解释性计算降到多项式时间。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.00496.en_title: ESENSC: A Polynomial-Time Axiomatic Alternative to SHAP
https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.00496.en_oneliner: ESENSC replaces SHAP with a deterministic closed-form attribution method, keeping theoretical grounding while bringing interpretability computation down to polynomial time.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06740.zh_title: ViroGym：面向病毒蛋白评估的真实大规模基准
https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06740.zh_oneliner: ViroGym 为蛋白质语言模型提供了一套真实的大规模基准，系统检验它们对病毒蛋白突变效应的零样本预测能力。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06740.en_title: ViroGym: Realistic Large-Scale Benchmarks for Evaluating Viral Proteins
https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.06740.en_oneliner: ViroGym gives protein language models a realistic large-scale benchmark to systematically test their zero-shot prediction of viral protein mutation effects.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.09527.zh_title: 用参数与数据高效适配让草稿模型对齐更高效
https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.09527.zh_oneliner: 这项研究用参数和数据都更省的适配方法对齐推测解码的草稿模型，缓解目标模型微调后草稿模型性能下降的问题。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.09527.en_title: Efficiently Aligning Draft Models via Parameter- and Data-Efficient Adaptation
https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.09527.en_oneliner: This work aligns speculative-decoding draft models with parameter- and data-efficient adaptation, easing the performance drop draft models suffer after target models are fine-tuned.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.09600.zh_title: 神经元回路学习的变分潜在均衡
https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.09600.zh_oneliner: 这项研究提出变分潜在均衡框架，解释大脑如何识别和生成复杂时空模式，并为类脑学习提供新的理论视角。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.09600.en_title: A Variational Latent Equilibrium for Learning in Neuronal Circuits
https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.09600.en_oneliner: This work proposes a variational latent equilibrium framework to explain how brains recognize and generate complex spatiotemporal patterns, offering a new theoretical lens for brain-like learning.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.14667.zh_title: 3D 卷积与 2.5D 切片条件 U-Net 在 MRI 超分辨率中的对比分析
https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.14667.zh_oneliner: 这项研究对比了两种 U-Net 架构在扩散模型驱动的 MRI 超分辨率上的表现，帮助选择更适合低分辨率影像增强的方案。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.14667.en_title: Comparative Analysis of 3D Convolutional and 2.5D Slice-Conditioned U-Net Architectures for MRI Super-Resolution via Elucidated Diffusion Models
https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.14667.en_oneliner: This study compares two U-Net architectures for diffusion-driven MRI super-resolution, helping choose the better option for enhancing low-resolution scans.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.15854.zh_title: FlashSampling：快速省内存的精确采样
https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.15854.zh_oneliner: FlashSampling 解决了大词表解码时采样带来的额外内存开销，让分类分布采样在推理中更快、更省内存。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.15854.en_title: FlashSampling: Fast and Memory-Efficient Exact Sampling
https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.15854.en_oneliner: FlashSampling removes the extra memory traffic that sampling causes in large-vocabulary decoding, making categorical sampling faster and more memory-efficient during inference.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.26378.zh_title: 面向蛋白质设计的生成式机器学习
https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.26378.zh_oneliner: 这篇综述梳理了生成式机器学习如何设计具有特定生物功能的蛋白质，覆盖新药研发与工程化蛋白的最新进展。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.26378.en_title: Generative machine learning for protein design
https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.26378.en_oneliner: This review surveys how generative machine learning designs proteins with specific biological functions, covering recent advances for therapeutics and engineered proteins.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07953.zh_title: 时间序列分类的剪枝扩展与效率权衡
https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07953.zh_oneliner: 这项研究在时间序列分类中平衡预测性能与资源消耗，用剪枝扩展让大规模分类更可持续。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07953.en_title: Pruning Extensions and Efficiency Trade-Offs for Sustainable Time Series Classification
https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.07953.en_oneliner: This study balances predictive performance against resource consumption in time series classification, using pruning extensions to make large-scale classification more sustainable.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11578.zh_title: 在变分测量型量子计算中最小化生成建模的经典资源
https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11578.zh_oneliner: 这项研究减少了变分测量型量子计算做生成建模时所需的经典计算资源，让量子生成模型更接近实际可用。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11578.en_title: Minimizing classical resources in variational measurement-based quantum computation for generative modeling
https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.11578.en_oneliner: This work reduces the classical computing resources that variational measurement-based quantum computation needs for generative modeling, bringing quantum generative models closer to practical use.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14397.zh_title: 用词典跨语言义项投影生成概念词汇化
https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14397.zh_oneliner: 这项研究通过词典把词义从一种语言投影到另一种语言，自动为 WordNet 式词汇资源扩展新语言的词条。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14397.en_title: Generating Concept Lexicalizations via Dictionary-Based Cross-Lingual Sense Projection
https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14397.en_oneliner: Through dictionaries, the study projects word senses from one language into another, automatically adding entries for new languages to WordNet-style lexical resources.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14586.zh_title: CPGRec+：面向个性化游戏推荐的平衡框架
https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14586.zh_oneliner: CPGRec+ 针对游戏行业快速变化的推荐需求，在个性化与多样性之间做平衡，让游戏推荐更贴合玩家口味。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14586.en_title: CPGRec+: A Balance-oriented Framework for Personalized Video Game Recommendations
https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.14586.en_oneliner: CPGRec+ balances personalization and diversity for the fast-changing game industry, making game recommendations better matched to players' tastes.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17714.zh_title: 先筛查再解读：面向基准测试的 LLM 置信度信号便携有效性筛查
https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17714.zh_oneliner: 这项研究提出一个便携的筛查方法，先验证大模型的置信度信号是否真的随正确率变化，再用它来做弃答、路由和升级决策。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17714.en_title: Screen Before You Interpret: A Portable Validity Screen for Benchmark-Based LLM Confidence Signals
https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17714.en_oneliner: This work proposes a portable screen that first checks whether an LLM's confidence signal actually varies with correctness before using it for abstention, routing, and escalation decisions.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27308.zh_title: BoostLoRA：用 Boosting 提升适配器的有效秩
https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27308.zh_oneliner: BoostLoRA 通过 Boosting 思路扩大适配器的有效秩，化解了超低参数适配器表达能力不足与尺寸之间的权衡。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27308.en_title: BoostLoRA: Growing Effective Rank by Boosting Adapters
https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.27308.en_oneliner: BoostLoRA grows adapters' effective rank through boosting, resolving the tradeoff between ultra-low-parameter adapter size and expressivity.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.04081.zh_title: 含可变滞后的时间序列因果发现
https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.04081.zh_oneliner: 这项研究用因果贝叶斯网络处理随时间演化的问题，允许变量之间的滞后随时间变化，让时间序列因果发现更贴近现实。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.04081.en_title: Time series causal discovery with variable lags
https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.04081.en_oneliner: This work uses causal Bayesian networks to handle problems that evolve over time, allowing variable lags between variables so time-series causal discovery fits reality better.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07398.zh_title: 揭示并缓解深度伪造视频检测中的时间攻击
https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07398.zh_oneliner: 研究发现，尽管时空深度伪造检测器的 AUC 很高，但它们容易受到时序规避攻击，这项工作揭示了这一弱点并给出缓解方法。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07398.en_title: Exposing and Mitigating Temporal Attack in Deepfake Video Detection
https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07398.en_oneliner: The study reveals that spatiotemporal deepfake detectors, despite high AUC scores, are vulnerable to temporal evasion attacks, and it proposes mitigations for this weakness.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10005.zh_title: 机械与智能体混合的规约推断
https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10005.zh_oneliner: 这项研究把机械化推断与智能体结合起来，自动补齐形式化验证所需的高层规约，降低人工编写规约的成本。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10005.en_title: Hybrid Mechanical and Agentic Specification Inference
https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.10005.en_oneliner: This work combines mechanical inference with agents to automatically fill in the high-level specifications formal verification needs, lowering the cost of writing specifications by hand.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16573.zh_title: 小波流匹配：面向多尺度物理仿真
https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16573.zh_oneliner: 这项研究用小波流匹配仿真由偏微分方程支配的多尺度物理系统，在长时间自回归展开中保持稳定。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16573.en_title: Wavelet Flow Matching for Multi-Scale Physics Emulation
https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.16573.en_oneliner: This work uses wavelet flow matching to emulate multi-scale physical systems governed by PDEs while staying stable over long autoregressive rollouts.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22355.zh_title: TransitLM：面向无地图公交路线生成的大规模数据集与基准
https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22355.zh_oneliner: TransitLM 提供了一个大规模数据集和基准，让模型无需结构化地图基础设施就能规划公交路线。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22355.en_title: TransitLM: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Map-Free Transit Route Generation
https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22355.en_oneliner: TransitLM provides a large-scale dataset and benchmark so models can plan public transit routes without structured map infrastructure.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22781.zh_title: DeltaBox：面向有状态 AI 智能体的毫秒级沙箱检查点与回滚
https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22781.zh_oneliner: DeltaBox 让大模型驱动的智能体工作负载能以毫秒级频率做沙箱状态检查点和回滚，支撑测试时树搜索和强化学习等高频状态探索场景。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22781.en_title: DeltaBox: Millisecond-Scale Sandbox Checkpoint and Rollback for Stateful AI Agents
https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22781.en_oneliner: DeltaBox lets LLM-powered agent workloads checkpoint and roll back sandbox state at millisecond scale, supporting high-frequency state exploration like test-time tree search and reinforcement learning.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07923.zh_title: Larch：面向语义谓词的学习型查询优化
https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07923.zh_oneliner: 随着大模型让数据库引入语义算子，Larch 用学习方法优化带语义谓词的分析查询，让非结构化数据上的查询更快。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07923.en_title: Larch: Learned Query Optimization for Semantic Predicates
https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.07923.en_oneliner: As LLMs bring semantic operators into databases, Larch uses learned optimization to speed up analytical queries with semantic predicates over unstructured data.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.32034.zh_title: QVal：面向长程 LLM 智能体的密集监督信号评估
https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.32034.zh_oneliner: QVal 评估长程智能体任务中密集监督信号的质量，因为只看最终结果的奖励说不清哪些中间动作做得好。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.32034.en_title: QVal: Evaluating Dense Supervision Signals for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.32034.en_oneliner: QVal grades the quality of dense supervision signals on long-horizon agent tasks, since rewards based only on final outcomes can't tell which intermediate steps went well.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03836.zh_title: 简单更有效：中世纪拉丁手稿翻译流程评测
https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03836.zh_oneliner: 研究发现，视觉-语言模型在中世纪手稿这类历史文本上表现吃力，而更简单的翻译流程反而更可靠。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03836.en_title: When Simpler Is Better: Evaluating Translation Pipelines for Medieval Latin Manuscripts
https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.03836.en_oneliner: The study finds vision-language models struggle with historical manuscripts, while simpler translation pipelines prove more reliable for medieval Latin texts.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04688.zh_title: URSA：面向实用逆合成评估的化学感知基准
https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04688.zh_oneliner: URSA 提供了一个化学感知的基准，用来评估为目标分子寻找合成路线的规划能力，服务药物发现中的逆合成任务。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04688.en_title: URSA: Chemistry-Aware Benchmark for Utilitarian Retrosynthesis Assessment
https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04688.en_oneliner: URSA provides a chemistry-aware benchmark for evaluating synthesis planning that finds reaction pathways for target molecules, serving retrosynthesis in drug discovery.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04926.zh_title: 输入路径影响小样本而非零样本绑定：小型 Transformer 的全枚举研究
https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04926.zh_oneliner: 这项全枚举研究发现，信息以符号、干净编码还是纠缠感知向量进入 Transformer，会影响小样本绑定能力，但对零样本绑定影响不大。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04926.en_title: Input Pathways Shape Few-Shot, Not Zero-Shot, Binding in Tiny Transformers: A Fully-Enumerable Study
https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.04926.en_oneliner: This fully-enumerable study finds that how information reaches a transformer — as symbols, clean oracle codes, or entangled perceptual vectors — affects few-shot binding but not zero-shot binding.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.07738.zh_title: REFORGE：评测大模型逆向工程能力的基准方法
https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.07738.zh_oneliner: REFORGE 用反编译二进制函数命名任务来评测大模型的逆向工程能力，回应了威胁情报中大模型参与逆向工程的现实。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.07738.en_title: REFORGE: A Method for Benchmarking LLMs' Reverse Engineering Capabilities in Decompiled Binary Function Naming
https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.07738.en_oneliner: REFORGE benchmarks LLM reverse-engineering capability through decompiled binary function naming, responding to real threat-intelligence reports of LLMs being used for reverse engineering.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.07824.zh_title: CPM-MultiAgent：模拟医疗对话中患者情绪动态演变的评估框架
https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.07824.zh_oneliner: 这个框架用多智能体模拟患者在医疗对话中的情绪变化，帮助培训医护沟通，让学习者练习回应临床场景。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.07824.en_title: CPM-MultiAgent: A CPM-Grounded Appraisal Framework for Simulating Dynamic Patient Emotional Evolution in Healthcare Dialogue
https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.07824.en_oneliner: This framework uses multiple agents to simulate how patient emotions evolve in healthcare dialogue, helping train clinical communication skills.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20289.zh_title: 礼貌预判：改善持久共享环境中的长效任务规划
https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20289.zh_oneliner: 这项研究让共享同一环境的机器人能礼貌地预判彼此的任务安排，提升长期任务规划的协同效率。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20289.en_title: Courteous Anticipation: Improving Long-Lived Task Planning in Persistent Shared Environments
https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.20289.en_oneliner: This work lets robots sharing a persistent environment courteously anticipate each other's task schedules, improving coordination in long-lived task planning.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.29617.zh_title: 在策略交互何时有帮助：基于价值的模仿学习中的表征权衡
https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.29617.zh_oneliner: 这项研究分析了在基于价值的模仿学习中，与环境在线交互在什么情况下真正有帮助，以及背后的表征权衡。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.29617.en_title: When Does On-Policy Interaction Help? Representational Tradeoffs in Value-Based Imitation Learning
https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.29617.en_oneliner: This study analyses when interacting with the environment online actually helps in value-based imitation learning, and the representational tradeoffs behind it.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15664.zh_title: 云边协同 LLM 学习：加速个性化双层优化
https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15664.zh_oneliner: 这项研究让云端与边缘的大模型协同学习，通过加速个性化双层优化，支撑物理世界智能的分布式训练。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15664.en_title: Cloud-Edge LLM Collaborative Learning via Accelerating Personalized Bilevel Optimization
https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.15664.en_oneliner: This work enables cloud and edge LLMs to learn collaboratively by accelerating personalized bilevel optimization, supporting distributed training for physical-world intelligence.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.27593.zh_title: 藏起来而非删除：网络如何压制纠缠特征
https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.27593.zh_oneliner: 这项研究揭示，当神经网络不再报告某个特征时，它可能只是把特征藏了起来而非遗忘，这对理解共享表征有重要意义。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.27593.en_title: Hidden not Deleted: How Networks Suppress Entangled Features
https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.27593.en_oneliner: The study shows a neural network that stops reporting a feature may simply be hiding it, not forgetting it — a finding with big implications for how shared representations work.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35348.zh_title: 从数据到程序：基于经验数据的快速直接生成式程序推断
https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35348.zh_oneliner: PRODiGI 是一个预训练模型，能直接从有限样本中推断出生成数据的程序，省去了针对每个数据集单独拟合的麻烦。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35348.en_title: From Data to Program: Fast & Direct Generative Program Inference from Empirical Data
https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.35348.en_oneliner: PRODiGI is a pretrained model that infers the program generating the data directly from a finite set of samples, skipping dataset-specific model fitting.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39626.zh_title: 用 StyleGAN 中间潜空间参数化油藏属性的集合数据同化方法
https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39626.zh_oneliner: 这项研究用 StyleGAN 的中间潜空间来参数化油藏属性，改进集合平滑器在历史拟合中的表现。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39626.en_title: Parameterization method of reservoir properties for ensemble-based data assimilation using intermediate latent space of StyleGAN
https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39626.en_oneliner: This work parameterizes reservoir properties with the intermediate latent space of StyleGAN to improve ensemble smoothers for history matching.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00890.zh_title: 智能体编码任务强化学习的跨基准迁移
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00890.zh_oneliner: 这项研究发现，编码智能体常在最后一公里掉链子：功能大体建成却丢了需求或测试不全，而在编码任务上做的强化学习可以在基准之间迁移。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00890.en_title: Cross-Benchmark Transfer from RL on Agentic Coding Tasks
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00890.en_oneliner: Coding agents often stumble at the finish line — most of a feature built, yet a requirement dropped or tests left incomplete — and RL trained on coding tasks carries across benchmarks, the study finds.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02771.zh_title: 1 比特反馈下近乎最优的固定置信度最优臂识别
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02771.zh_oneliner: 这项研究在每轮只有 1 比特反馈的严格约束下做最优臂识别，达到了近乎最优的固定置信度保证。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02771.en_title: Nearly Optimal Fixed-Confidence Best-Arm Identification with 1-Bit Feedback
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02771.en_oneliner: Working under a strict limit of 1 bit of feedback per round, the study identifies the best arm with near-optimal fixed-confidence guarantees.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03713.zh_title: 世界模型该遗忘什么：面向持续适应的分层保留
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03713.zh_oneliner: 这项研究指出，持续学习把所有性能下降都当作遗忘并不合理，世界模型应该分层保留知识，在适应新环境时有选择地遗忘。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03713.en_title: What Should World Models Forget? Stratified Retention for Continual Adaptation
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03713.en_oneliner: This study argues that continual learning wrongly treats any performance drop as forgetting, and that world models should retain knowledge in layers, forgetting selectively as they adapt.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13672.zh_title: 注入一轮而非一个 token：学习在何处重定向 LLM 推理以实现自我纠错
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13672.zh_oneliner: 这项研究不靠微调，而是学习在推理的哪个回合介入重定向，让大模型更可靠地发现并纠正自己的错误。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13672.en_title: Inject a Turn, Not a Token: Learning Where to Redirect LLM Reasoning for Self-Correction
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.13672.en_oneliner: Instead of fine-tuning, this work learns where in a reasoning trace to intervene and redirect, so LLMs can more reliably spot and correct their own errors.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21025.zh_title: 学会读出：语言模型预训练中的解嵌入动态
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21025.zh_oneliner: 这项研究追踪了语言模型在预训练中何时获得某项能力，发现关键不在何时答对，而在模型内部的读出机制何时形成。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21025.en_title: Learning to Read Out: Unembedding Dynamics in Language Model Pretraining
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.21025.en_oneliner: This study tracks when a language model acquires a capability during pretraining, finding the key is when its internal readout mechanism forms, not when it first answers correctly.

https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28411.zh_title: Brain2Vec：面向结构脑 MRI 的自监督 3D 基础模型
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28411.zh_oneliner: Brain2Vec 是一个自监督 3D 基础模型，让结构脑 MRI 的多种任务无需端到端重训就能开展，降低了医学影像的训练门槛。
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28411.en_title: Brain2Vec: A Self-Supervised 3D Foundation Model for Structural Brain MRI
https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.28411.en_oneliner: Brain2Vec is a self-supervised 3D foundation model that lets diverse structural brain MRI tasks run without end-to-end retraining, lowering the training barrier for medical imaging.
